sample_size_rationale: Three independent campaigns are proposed only for feasibility/variance estimation; confirmatory n remains unset until the relevant effect and paired SD are specified. See sample_size_scenarios.csv; technical wells do not increase independent n.
normalization_and_curve_model: Proposed: retain raw plate reads and controls; validate interference before normalization; fit dose-response per independent campaign only when supported; no forced extrapolated IC50 and no automatic truncation of normalized responses.
multiple_comparisons_plan: Proposed: one predeclared main contrast per candidate at 72h, Holm familywise correction across three candidates; other times and endpoints descriptive unless separately prespecified.
randomization_and_plate_layout: Proposed: reproducible 96-well paired cellular/cell-free layout from pilot_design.json; separate plates per destructive time point, fixed seed and all controls retained.
orthogonal_assay: Proposed: image-based cell/nuclei counting with validated particle/fluorescence controls; availability and settings require laboratory review.
physical_mixture_control_decision: Proposed inclusion of free drug plus empty nanoparticle at matched nominal drug and carrier doses.
non_estimable_ic50_policy: Report no crossing within tested range; do not force a point IC50 or silently extrapolate.
proposal_status: All filled methodological choices are proposed, not laboratory-approved or experimentally validated.
minimum_relevant_improvement_definition: Proposed relative reduction of IC50; value must be chosen scientifically before confirmatory results, not inferred from the exploratory ranking.
endothelial_assessment_proposal: Measure viability and orthogonal cell count, with validated acceptance thresholds still unset.
transwell_assessment_proposal: Distinguish free drug, total drug and particle-associated signal; verify barrier integrity and recovery across compartments. Analyte and numeric acceptance criteria remain unset.
